messages:
sara: heads up — planning to cut release/1.14 tomorrow at 3pm PT. who can create the branch and own the initial backports?
liam: I can create the branch, will do it at 3pm PT. do we have a cutoff list to reference?
jen: cutoff = bugfixes + docs only after 3pm. no new features. backport process: add label `backport/1.14`, assign to a reviewer and to me for approval. we prefer automated cherry-picks but manual ok for conflicts.
mike: quick q — if my PR needs a manual cherry-pick with conflicts, what’s the recommended flow? can someone help with resolving?
mike: ```
# create branch locally
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/1.14 origin/main
git push origin release/1.14

# cherry-pick example
git checkout release/1.14
git cherry-pick -x <SHA>
# if conflict: resolve files, then
git add .
git commit --no-edit
git push origin release/1.14
```
liam: thanks — i'll create the branch and post the branch PR here. @mike if you expect conflicts drop the PR link and i'll help with the cherry-pick or pair on resolves.
release-bot: scheduled action: create release branch requested by liam at 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z — will open branch PR automatically.
jen: reminder: changelog entries due EOD today. if you don't add one we'll default to 'misc fixes'. :memo:
sara: also quick ops note — set the release pipeline in Buildkite to run smoke tests only for backports (no full integration) to speed validation.
liam: created release/1.14 and opened the branch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/release/1.14 — tagging @jen for backport approvals.
mike: posted backport PR that needs manual resolve: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9876 — i've added label backport/1.14 and assigned to jen.
jen: approved for backport after smoke pass. i'll take the manual conflict resolution on that PR unless someone else wants it. :+1:
sara: thanks everyone — closing the loop: checklist for cut tomorrow = 1) changelogs done, 2) backports labeled/approved, 3) branch PR merged, 4) tag + release cut at 3pm PT. ping here if any blockers.
